settings.text: SCHLUESSELKINDER is a label system. Cold underground. Radical reduction. Bass pressure as architecture.
Objects are dispatched in limited runs. Each carries a signal — drop, capsule, soundsystem reference. Once a signal closes, the run does not return.
Not horror. Not cyberpunk. Not moodboard. A frequency.
All transmissions originate from the district. SNUFFRAGGA SOUNDSYSTEM is the working line; SHIBARI KAWAII is the first artist on record. More signals to follow.
